data.title: 堀京子 · 厨房尝味的侧脸
data.description: 居家灶台边，她扎着头发、穿围裙，用勺子尝了一口炖菜后微微皱眉，转身调整火候；窗外的天色是傍晚的橘色，整个画面是踏实的生活温度。
data.action: 束发系围裙尝一勺炖菜，皱眉思考后调整火候。
data.promptProse: Kyouko Hori tastes a spoonful of stew at the home stove, frowns thoughtfully, then turns her free hand to adjust the heat. Her blue cotton apron covers a cream T-shirt and dark trousers, tied chestnut hair clear of the pan. The medium view includes the pot and counter behind. Orange evening light from the window warms apron edges and spoon bowl, with deeper stove-side shadows and pale steam rising above the food.
